page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated physical CPU cores with 1 thread per core, resulting in 2 vCPUs. The instance is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per CPU core.

This server type does not include bundled local storage, meaning all storage must be attached externally. It does not feature any GPU accelerators, and it includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Additionally, advanced CPU instruction sets such as AVX, AVX512, AMX, AES cryptography, and virtualization extensions are not available on this hardware profile.

With its dedicated CPU allocation and 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.s2.xlarge offers an entry-level general-purpose resource profile. It is qualitatively positioned as a cost-efficient option for workloads that require dedicated CPU resources but do not demand high-performance vector processing, hardware-accelerated cryptography, or local storage. Suitable workloads include lightweight web serving, basic application hosting, and small development or staging environments.
